help_intro: Legado Vivo and Asistente Puente manual: capture memories over WhatsApp and turn them into editorial PDF albums.
help_memory_d: Each memory holds a title, photo or video, story, date, place and people. Limits: video up to 200 MB; photo and audio up to 100 MB; documents up to 20 MB. Uploads show a progress bar and explain any failure. Formats: images JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, SVG and RAW; videos MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM, WMV, 3GP, MTS, MPG, OGV; audios MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC, WMA, OPUS; documents PDF, Word (.docx) and text (.txt, .md). You can also paste a YouTube or Instagram video URL into "Video by URL", or an image link (or Instagram post) into "Photo by URL": it downloads itself and is saved with the memory. The attached document keeps its original file for download and its content is extracted as the memory's narrative (and becomes searchable). For video prefer MP4 (H.264): it plays in every browser. Videos show a thumbnail of their first frame with the ▶ badge. With the "Generate AI comment" checkbox (needs an OpenAI key on the server), the AI writes a short, warm comment from the title and narrative; you can regenerate it when editing the memory. You can also paste directly (Ctrl+V or ⌘V) a copied image, video, audio or document: it lands in its own form field. You can attach several photos per memory (up to 10): multi-select, drag and drop, or paste several at once; they show as a gallery and you can remove them when editing. With the art editor (🎨 button on the memory) you can apply charcoal, pop art, caricature or watercolor styles to any photo: everything is processed in your browser, nothing is uploaded to external services, and the stylized version is saved as another photo of the memory.

help_assistant_d: Asistente Puente is your archivist on WhatsApp: +1 555-153-9713 (save it as "Asistente Puente"). Send it the photo of the moment and tell what happened by text or voice note; it transcribes the audio, shows you the text to verify, asks whether you want to add people and date, and sends the memory to Legado Vivo as a "Pending completion" draft. It understands free phrasing: "save this photo", "how did what we started turn out?".
help_capture_d:
1. Open the chat with Asistente Puente (+1 555-153-9713) and send the photo.
2. It asks for the story: write it or send a voice note.
3. If it was audio, it transcribes it and shows you the text.
4. Answer "yes" to add people and date.
5. The "Pending completion" draft appears in your family: complete it on the web.
help_workshop_d: In the Workshop you pick memories with filters (date, people, word/topic), order them by dragging with ⋮⋮ or with ↑ ↓ —that order is the PDF order—, write a general narrative (optional) and choose a visual theme: General, Family, Birthday, Christmas, Travel or Wedding/Anniversary. With the ＋📖 button you interleave interstitial stories: blocks with their own title and mini-story ("The arrival", "The match"), independent from the opening narrative, used to separate chapters.
help_pdf_d: Downloading gives you a laid-out document: a cover with title, author, date and theme decoration; a narrative page; one memory per page (image on top, never split or distorted, story below); a dedicated page for each intermediate story with a book icon; a header with the album title and page number in the footer. No blank pages. The theme decoration reaches every page: a top band and rules in the theme color, a decorated initial at the start of the story, a double frame on photos and subtle diamonds in the corners and footer. Each memory with audio includes the "Listen to audio" button, which opens the recording in your browser. Memories with a document show a card with its name and the extracted narrative; if you generated the AI comment, it appears as a closing note.
help_library_d: Your albums are saved in the Workshop library. Open shows the album on the web; Edit returns to the builder with everything preloaded to adjust title, narrative, theme, memories, stories and order; Download PDF regenerates the document with the latest changes (no need to rebuild anything); Delete removes the album with confirmation (memories are not deleted).
help_roles_d: Admin: everything — invites, changes roles, edits and deletes. Collaborator: creates and edits memories and albums, downloads PDF. Reader: only views and downloads. The invitation message includes the Asistente Puente number so new members can archive over WhatsApp from day one.
help_trouble_d:
• Video does not play → use MP4 (H.264); AVI/MKV do not run in every browser.
• "Origin not allowed" when saving → the app URL must be in the server's allowed origins.
• The WhatsApp draft never appears → the bridge needs its 3 variables on the assistant server.
• The assistant does not reply → it may be "asleep" (free plan): wait ~30 seconds and write again.
• Video/photo by URL fails with "login required" or "rate-limit" → Instagram requires login for stories and sometimes for posts: use a public YouTube link or a public Instagram post/reel.

help_batch_d: Save WhatsApp files to your device. In New memory or Edit, use Photos and videos to select several files, or drag them into the box. You can mix photos and videos: the maximum is 10 items per memory, including existing items. Review previews and press × to remove a new file. While editing, check Remove for saved items you want to delete. Press Save and wait for the upload to finish. Each photo supports up to 100 MB and each video up to 200 MB. Video playback depends on browser format support.
help_art_d: Open a memory and press 🎨 Art editor next to Edit. Choose an existing photo or upload one, select Charcoal, Pop art, Cartoon or Watercolor and press Save to memory. A copy is added and the original is preserved.
help_docs_d: Attach a PDF, Word (.docx), TXT or Markdown file up to 25 MB. Its text appears as narrative and can be found with Search. Scanned PDFs without text need OCR first; the attachment is retained even without extracted narrative.
help_sidecar_d: Open a saved album in Workshop and select Download album .md beside PDF and HTML. One file contains the title, narrative, stories and memories in album order. Frontmatter includes each memory’s date, place and people. Unknown dates are omitted and approximate dates are marked. Markdown contains text and metadata; use HTML for photos, video and audio.
